cry verb

weep

also cry over, weep for, cry bitterly, weep bitterly, weep, cry (of a baby), wail (of a baby), shed tears, whine

classical

Traupman 151, 406

plōrō, plōrāre, plōrāvī, plōrātum

verb, first conjugation

Other words

  • fleō, flēre, flēvī, flētum — to weep; with an accusative, to weep for

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 151; Traupman 299

  • vāgiō, vāgīre, vāgīvī — (of a baby) cry, wail

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical · Varr. ap. Gell. (Lewis & Short); Traupman 299

  • lacrimās effundere (profundere) — shed tears

    also used · classical · Cic. Planc. 101; profundere, Cic. Font. 38 (Lewis & Short s.v. lacrima); Traupman 377; Traupman 391

Examples

  • ūbertim flēre

    to cry bitterlyTraupman 280

  • graviter lacrimāre

    to cry bitterlyTraupman 280

  • plōrāre

    to whineTraupman 406

See also tear, wail, hurt, comfort.
